name: MiniLab 3
source: Not from Arturia: they publish no chart for it. Found by testing and shared at https://gist.github.com/Janiczek/04a87c2534b9d1435a1d8159c742d260 (the colour message, and pad ids 04-0B for bank A and 14-1B for bank B, from a comment there). Arturia's header is F0 00 20 6B 7F 42.
notes: The pads are addressed by id, and Soba knows which is which by the note each sends from the factory: bank A 36-43 and bank B 44-51 on channel 10. A controller set up otherwise in MIDI Control Center needs its notes here. The colour message's 02 02 is said to set the DAW mode's colours (02 01 the Arturia mode's, 02 00 the current User mode's); whether the pads take it in every mode, and whether DAW mode must be entered first, is still to be checked by hand (#430). On Windows the MiniLab shows two output ports, and Arturia's own scripts send SysEx to the second (MIDIOUT2).
